# SOL Prep

> SOL Prep (https://solprep.com) is a free study resource for Virginia's Standards of Learning (SOL) exams — practice tests, standards guides, and an AI study assistant for students in grades 3–12 across Math, English/Reading, Science, and History & Social Science.

Practice questions are drawn from official Virginia Department of Education (VDOE) released SOL tests. SOL Prep is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Virginia Department of Education.

## Practice tests
- [All SOL practice tests](https://solprep.com/practice): Free Virginia SOL practice questions by course, with instant answer checking.
- [Math SOL practice](https://solprep.com/sol/math): Algebra 1, Geometry, Algebra 2, and grades 3–8.
- [English/Reading SOL practice](https://solprep.com/sol/english): Reading practice by grade, 3–12.
- [Science SOL practice](https://solprep.com/sol/science): Biology, Chemistry, Earth Science, and grades 3–8.
- [History SOL practice](https://solprep.com/sol/history): Civics & Economics, World History/Geography, US History.
